text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 26, 2025) for 10 Elvaston Drive.

The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (July 26, 2025) for 10 Elvaston Drive, Folder Number 25 200499 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to June 30, 2026.
